items.title: Starbucks (SBUX) Stock Looks Overvalued On Current Assumptions
items.summary: Starbucks has delivered a solid year to date gain, yet current valuation checks suggest the stock is trading at a premium to what its cash flows and market multiples imply. Both the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate and the broader multiple based view point to Starbucks stock as overvalued on today’s assumptions. items.title: Starbucks (SBUX) Brings A New Wellness Bar To Stores Nationwide
items.summary: Starbucks (NasdaqGS:SBUX) has begun an in-store retail rollout of Floura Fiber's Blueberry Matcha Daily Fiber Bar across its U.S. locations. The launch brings a wellness focused snack option directly to Starbucks customers alongside existing beverage and food offerings. The partnership introduces Floura Fiber's branded product to Starbucks' nationwide retail footprint, expanding reach for both companies. items.title: The Sisterhood of the Traveling Brand Sponsorships
items.summary: What began as a peek into sorority pledge season has morphed into a highly produced, brand-sponsored annual dance bonanza, with this school year’s new clips brought to you in part by Poppi, Benefit Cosmetics and Lucky Charms.  To learn more about how this hyperspecific marketing niche is evolving, I tracked down Jake Motyl, founder of college marketing agency CampusLaunch, who has been shuttling between sorority houses to produce sponsored content for clients like Bodyarmor and Nike.
